title: fix(metadata-protocol): a packaged action or permission set's refusal names its own sanctioned path (ADR-0126 Regime C rows)
body:
Fixes #20910
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

ADR-0126 §3 puts `flow`, `action` and `permission` in Regime C, and §2 requires the Regime C refusal to name the sanctioned path. Before this PR, only `flow`'s package-less refusal at the environment-scoped package door did that. Every other refusal of an in-place write onto one of these packaged items prescribed the `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE` hatch or a redeploy, and a packaged action's removal named no path at all.

This PR follows triage's direction on the card (one regime, per-type sanctioned routes, the sentence built from the row) and the seat answer on Q1 and Q2 (comment 5923536089):

- **One table, one new module.** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/packaged-base-regime.ts` holds `PACKAGED_BASE_REGIME`. Each row is `{ regime, routes }`, and `routes` declares only the primitives the type has: `clone`, `switchOff`, or both. A row that names neither does not compile. The module builds the prescription (the row's paths in a fixed order, clone then switch, then the ADR-0126 citation) and the whole package-door sentence. Nothing in it reads the type.
  - The module is not exported from the package entry.
  - It lives in its own module because `protocol.ts` imports `sys-metadata-repository.ts`, so the table could not live in either file without an import cycle.
- **Rows:**
  - `flow`: clone (`POST /api/v1/automation/:name/clone`) and switch (`POST /api/v1/automation/:name/toggle`).
  - `action`: the switch only, `POST /api/v1/actions/_activation/:object/:action` with `{enabled: false}`, where `:object` is `global` for an object-less action. No clone, because the action-clone half is not chartered. Its operator-only clause matches the flow toggle's, since both routes run the one ADR-0126 §5 gate.
  - `permission`: the clone only, spelled as `plugin-security`'s own lock refusal spells it.
- **Three doors read it. No door has a per-type prose branch.**
  1. The protocol's package door (`refusePackagedBaseOverride` / `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`), on an environment-scoped kernel, answers `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`. `flow`'s sentence is byte-identical, held by a literal pin.
  2. **The repository's type door** (`SysMetadataRepository.assertAllowed`) is where a write lands when the `/meta` protocol is not environment-scoped, which includes the default `pnpm dev` boot. For an override-artifact write with the hatch closed, on a type with a row, it now answers the same row-built sentence, `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, on save and on removal. Every other type keeps the overlay-allowed-list sentence and its pins.
  3. **The named-base `ITEM_LOCKED` limb** (`readOnlyBaseOverrideError`) applies with the hatch closed, on a type with a row. Its opener is shortened to "Cannot overlay 'TYPE' in package 'ID': that package is read-only, and its packaged base is locked against in-place edits.", followed by the row's prescription and the ADR-0126 citation.
     - Unchanged: the hatch-OPEN remedy, `code`, `status`, `lockSource`, `packageId` and `docs`.
     - Unchanged: NARROW. A package-less hatch write still lands, and that is pinned.
- **The #8146 hatch-closed pin moved and was not deleted.** It now sits on `page`, a type with no regime row, and is measured to reach the same limb (`ITEM_LOCKED`, `lockSource: 'package'`, the named base echoed back). A Regime C pin sits beside it, and the pin's comment cites ADR-0126 §2 as the reason the two sentences differ.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` had two sentences that contradicted the new text, and both are corrected:
  - "a create/update aimed at a read-only package … is asked to pick or create a writable base";
  - the `permission` row's "edit the package and re-publish".
  - A short "Packaged flows, actions and permission sets (ADR-0126)" subsection lists each type's sanctioned path.

No code, status, route or refused write moves.

**The `Clause-②: no` check** (the seat answer's stop (a)). `assertAllowed` / `assertDeleteAllowed` now take the ref and the operation, and both are `private`. `readOnlyBaseOverrideError`'s signature is unchanged. Measured on the built declarations, with comments stripped, before against after this round (`dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`): the only lines that differ are the removal of three `private static` member names on `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` (`PACKAGED_BASE_REGIME`, `PACKAGED_BASE_REFUSAL_BY_REGIME`, `packagedBaseRegimeSentence`), which the table move took out of the class. No exported signature moved, and the new module appears nowhere in the declarations. **The seat answer's stop (b)**: no type without a regime row changes its sentence at any door. The controls are `page` and `object` here, and `page` on the booted app below.

**Lengths** against the REST door's 500-character bound (`truncateClientMessage` keeps a message only while it is shorter than 500):

| Refusal | Row | Characters before the variable part | Longest variable part that arrives whole | Pin |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Package door / type door (save / removal) | `flow` | 411 / 404 before the name | 88-character name | yes |
| Package door / type door (save / removal) | `action` | 365 / 358 before the name | 88-character name | yes |
| Package door / type door (save) | `permission` | 317 before the name | 88-character name | yes |
| `ITEM_LOCKED` named base | `flow` | 422 before the package id | 77-character package id | 64-character id |
| `ITEM_LOCKED` named base | `action` | 376 before the package id | 123-character package id | 64-character id |
| `ITEM_LOCKED` named base | `permission` | 328 before the package id | 171-character package id | 64-character id |

The longest package id this repository ships is `com.objectstack.platform-objects.activation-ledger`, at 50 characters.

## Measured

**Booted showcase** (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`, local mode, discovery `scoping.enabled: false`). Before is the previous head of this PR, `d9b1a8e8b`, byte-identical to `origin/main` `7fa67dada`. After is `9c169378a`.

| request | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/showcase_task_completed?package=com.example.showcase` | `403 ITEM_LOCKED` "…locked against runtime edits. Edit the source artifact and redeploy, or set OS_METADATA_WRITABLE=flow to grant a runtime escape hatch on this TYPE (…pair it with a package-less write). See docs/adr/0010-…" | `403 ITEM_LOCKED` "Cannot overlay 'flow' in package 'com.example.showcase': that package is read-only, and its packaged base is locked against in-place edits. Clone it under a new name to customize it (POST /api/v1/automation/:name/clone, body {name, label}), or switch it off (POST /api/v1/automation/:name/toggle, body {enabled: false}; operator-only where one install serves several organizations). See docs/adr/0126-packaged-metadata-customization-model.md." |
| `PUT /api/v1/meta/action/showcase_mark_done` (type door) | `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` "'action' is not allowOrgOverride in the registry. Overlay-allowed: view, dashboard, report, translation, email_template. Set OS_METADATA_WRITABLE to enable additional types at runtime." | `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` "Metadata item 'action/showcase_mark_done' is provided by a code package, and its packaged base is locked against in-place edits. Switch it off (POST /api/v1/actions/_activation/:object/:action, body {enabled: false}, :object = global for an object-less action; operator-only where one install serves several organizations). See docs/adr/0126-…" |
| `PUT /api/v1/meta/action/showcase_mark_done?package=com.example.showcase` | `403 ITEM_LOCKED` "…Edit the source artifact and redeploy, or set OS_METADATA_WRITABLE=action …" | `403 ITEM_LOCKED` "Cannot overlay 'action' in package 'com.example.showcase': that package is read-only, and its packaged base is locked against in-place edits. Switch it off (…). See docs/adr/0126-…" |
| `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/showcase_task_completed` (package-less) | Regime C flow sentence | identical |
| `PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/showcase_contributor`, with and without `?package=` | `plugin-security`'s authoring gate, already naming the clone | identical (that gate answers first on this boot) |
| `DELETE` of the packaged flow, action and permission set | `200`, "No customization overlay found … already at artifact default" | identical |
| control: `PUT /api/v1/meta/page/showcase_start_here`, with and without `?package=` | — | still the list-and-hatch sentence and the hatch-closed `ITEM_LOCKED` remedy "…or set OS_METADATA_WRITABLE=page …", which is unchanged |

Of the nine readings, exactly the three rows above with a changed "after" column moved.

**In process, on an environment kernel** (`env_1`), the real `/meta` route handler over a real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` and `SchemaRegistry`, with the package booted as code. These are the earlier rounds' readings, still pinned:

- `PUT action` and `DELETE action` name the switch.
- `PUT permission` names the clone.
- `DELETE permission` is the `supportsOverlay` carve-out, not refused.
- `?package=` on both kernel shapes answers `ITEM_LOCKED` with the row's path.

**Docs drift** (`content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`, matched by `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`). Two sentences contradicted the new text and are corrected, as listed under "What this changes". The page names no `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE` prescription for a flow, action or permission edit. The docs-drift-check comment (5923480340) also lists four release-owned pages. They were read and none of them states this refusal; they are release-owned and were not touched.

## Tests

All at `9c169378a`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 195 files passed and 3 skipped; 2920 tests passed and 19 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck`: exit 0. The tsconfig includes `src/**/*`, tests included.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: exit 0, with `check:test-typecheck` OK.
- REST pins (`rest-meta-packaged-action-permission-refusal.test.ts` and `rest-meta-packaged-flow-refusal.test.ts`): 2 files, 15 tests passed.
- New and moved pins:
  - `sys-metadata-repository.package-writability.test.ts`:
    - the type door on save, for each row, with the exact sentence;
    - the type door on removal, for `flow` and `action`;
    - the type-door control on `object`, byte for byte;
    - NARROW, where a hatch write of a packaged action still lands package-less;
    - the named base with the hatch closed, for each row, with the exact sentence and the full envelope;
    - the named base with the hatch open, on `flow`, byte for byte as before;
    - the 64-character package-id bound;
    - the moved #8146 pin on `page`, and its Regime C neighbour.
  - `protocol.packaged-base-refusal.test.ts`: the named-base limb through `packagedBaseRefusal` on both kernel shapes. The earlier per-row, literal-`flow` and 88-character pins stand.
  - `protocol.delete-rewrap-envelope.test.ts`: the control-plane removal prose is partitioned by regime row. `flow` and `action` now read their removal sentence, and every other type reads the type-door sentence as before.
  - `rest-meta-packaged-action-permission-refusal.test.ts`: a host-config kernel's `PUT action` and `PUT permission` hit the type door and name the path. `?package=` for both types on both kernel shapes answers `ITEM_LOCKED` with the path.
- **Ablation**, run after committing `9c169378a`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. It deleted every row from the table (anchor 1 → 0, blob `7f06cc1d9f9a` → `b876c9500402`), rebuilt `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, and `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` reported the action-route marker absent from all 24 built files.
  - metadata-protocol pins: **24 failed** / 81 passed. Every regime pin went red, on all three doors, including flow's literal pin and both length bounds. These stayed green: the moved #8146 pin on `page`, the `object` type-door control, the hatch-open remedy, NARROW, the `page` controls and the delete-rewrap file (it partitions by the table, by design).
  - REST pins: **13 failed** / 2 passed. Only the permission `DELETE` carve-out and the `page` control stayed green.
  - Restore leg: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty; the rebuild exited 0; the marker is present in 2 built files; the working tree is clean.

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `9c169378a` (no paths, the change set from merge base `2f2fa11d7`, 9 paths) derives **92** commands. That is the earlier 62 plus the documentation families the `content/docs/concepts/` touch adds. All 92 were run there and **every one exited 0**.
- Reconciled with `--ran` against a `command :: exit N` record: "92 derived, 92 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", a derived zero.
- `origin/main` had not moved past the merge base when the gates were derived.
- The artifact-roster, wide-population, path-scheduled-job and type-check-lane families are outside the derived list and are left to CI.
- `pnpm lint` is CI's run and was not run here.

## Acceptance notes

- The permission row's wording is a copy of `plugin-security`'s (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/packaged-permission-set-lock.ts`), because `metadata-protocol` cannot import that package. Nothing pins the two spellings equal across packages. Noted, not filed.
